Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Prince Nikolaus Wilhelm’s mother (Princess Pauline of Württemberg) was “from” Russia, relying on search snippets/TLD heuristics and conflating two different Paulines of Württemberg (Pauline Therese, born in Riga, vs. Pauline Friederike Marie, 1810–1856, his actual mother from Württemberg). This misinterpreted “country of origin” (nationality/dynastic house) and led away from the correct answer: German.
